title: IDF Airstrikes Hit al-Mansouri, Houla, Kfar Tebnit, Khiam Despite Framework Deal
detail: Israeli forces carried out three airstrikes on the southern Lebanese town of al-Mansouri in the Tyre district, injuring seven people. Israeli forces also blew up homes in Houla in the Nabatieh district, a drone strike hit Kfar Tebnit, and Israeli troops set fires in the border town of Khiam that spread to remaining homes. The attacks came despite the US-brokered framework agreement signed the previous month establishing phased Israeli withdrawal from Lebanese territory.

media.caption: Smoke rises over southern Lebanon after Israeli strikes on al-Mansouri, Houla and Khiam
